          minLength: 1

          minLength: 1

          title: City

          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison

          title: Telephone number
          description: >-

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits.
            The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'; the stored value is
            that E.164 string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid email address; the stored value is lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it
            defaults to the server's current date. Serialized as an ISO date
            'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner already
            has the same last name and address (they share a household). A
            request-only flag; it is not stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where
                CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN a per-city
                4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'TOW-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners who belong to the same
                household (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is
                created with sharesHousehold true; every owner in that household
                carries the same value. Null when the owner is not part of a
                shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-

## Summary

I consolidated all owner duplicate detection into a single derived **`identityKey`** = `normalizedTelephone + "|" + (email or empty) + "|" + (householdId or empty)`, and a new owner is now rejected with **409** only when its *whole* key equals an existing owner's.

**What changed**

- **`Owner` model** — added a `@Transient getIdentityKey()` plus a shared `static identityKey(tel, email, householdId)` that defines the key's shape in one place (null/blank parts become empty segments). This is also now returned on the owner response.
- **`openapi.yml`** — added the read-only `identityKey` property to the `Owner` schema, so it's generated into `OwnerDto` and mapped out by MapStruct.
- **`EnsureUniqueIdentity`** (new function) — the single check: it normalizes the request's email, uses the already-E.164 telephone, derives the prospective `householdId` (only when `sharesHousehold` is set), builds the key via `Owner.identityKey(...)`, and rejects on an exact match against any existing owner's `getIdentityKey()`.
- **`DuplicateIdentityException`** + handler + escalation YAML (new) — maps to 409, same pattern as the old handlers.
- **`Households`** — now owns the `householdId`/`deriveHouseholdId` derivation (moved out of `AssignHousehold`) so the key check and household assignment share one source of truth.
- **`owners.POST.yml`** — the three steps `ensureUniqueTelephone` / `ensureUniqueEmail` / `ensureUniqueHousehold` are replaced by a single `ensureUniqueIdentity` step.
- **Removed** the three `EnsureUnique*` functions and the three `Duplicate{Telephone,Email,Household}` exceptions/handlers/escalation YAMLs, and fixed the now-stale javadoc links in `OwnerTelephones`/`OwnerEmails`.

**Behavioural effect**: because the telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household (same `householdId`) with different telephones now have distinct keys and are both allowed — only an exact full-key collision is a duplicate. The acceptance test `coreRejectsIdentityCollision` (same telephone ⇒ same key ⇒ 409) passes, and the full suite is green (`BUILD SUCCESS`, 1 test, 0 failures).
